body:
Pass 35. Ceiling bound for Epic 8, and a correction to my own method.

Correction: I started extrapolating the ceiling by shrinking active_slices, which is invalid - fewer slices truncate the searchlights, so mean k falls from 31.2 to 12.6 and per-support cost goes as k^3. That would have understated per-node cost ~18x. Discarded those numbers.

The bound needs no new computation: your gate at 52416 nodes and k=31.2 has run over 45 minutes without finishing. At fixed k, cost is near-linear in nodes, so 30 minutes corresponds to at most 52416*30/45 = 34944 nodes - and less, since it has not finished. So the dense-metric ceiling at this support size is below roughly 35000 nodes.

I am not measuring more precisely while your gate saturates a core, since those timings would measure the machine, not the code. Worth doing on a quiet machine with active_slices held at 24 and reduced in-plane extent so k stays near 31.

Epic 8 can close well without the exact figure: brain-scale diagonal/identity SUPPORTED (52k voxels, 166s); dense local metrics NOT supported at whole-brain node counts, ceiling below ~35000 nodes at support ~31, exact boundary to be pinned later.
